stem.text: An object falls from rest towards the ground.
Which graph shows the variation of the momentum $p$ of the object with time $t$ until it hits the ground?

A.alt: Graph with vertical axis p and horizontal axis t, origin 0. A horizontal straight line.

B.alt: Graph with vertical axis p and horizontal axis t, origin 0. A curve starting at the origin that rises and becomes less steep towards the right.

C.alt: Graph with vertical axis p and horizontal axis t, origin 0. A straight line starting at the origin and rising to the right.

D.alt: Graph with vertical axis p and horizontal axis t, origin 0. A curve starting at the origin that rises more steeply towards the right.
